realized_tradeoff_characterization: A2 avoids 347 Q4_WORSE early traps that trapped A1, reducing early trap exposure from 575 to 228 (-60.3%). However, A2 incurs a median confirmation cost of 2.00 pts on dual-confirmed trades and forfeits 777 Q4_BETTER early entries. Because P2 falls back to V_A for these 1,127 non-A2 trades, P2 suffers less premature-entry drag than P1, recovering +$6,570 in net PnL relative to P1 (-$74,100 vs -$80,670), but still failing to outperform C0 (-$73,080).
